note: Single source of numbers for the card holder model. cad/fusion/build.py
pushes these into the Fusion document as user parameters and builds every
feature from them, so no dimension is ever typed into a sketch by hand.
Coordinate system for the model (see build.py):
Z = 0   = board front face (F.Cu) -- the LCD/card side
Z < 0   = into the board; Z > 0 = out toward the card
status: verified = traced to a measurement or the hardware repo.
provisional = a starting point to be tuned on the coupon.

board.name: board_corner_r
board.comment: nominal corner radius; drawn arcs run R3.00-R3.12

board.name: hole_grid_x
board.comment: nominal hole pitch; exact per-hole XY comes from board.json

board.name: hole_grid_y
board.comment: nominal hole pitch; holes are not a perfect rectangle

stack.name: glass_z
stack.comment: LCD glass top above board front face = card rest plane

stack.name: clamp_stop_z
stack.comment: hard travel stop, bounds clamp force without TPU

card.name: art_w
card.comment: art window width (derived; confirm against a flatbed scan)

card.name: art_inset_l
card.comment: art window inset from card left (derived)

card.name: art_inset_r
card.comment: art window inset from card right (derived)

card.name: art_inset_t
card.comment: art window inset from card top (derived)

card.name: sleeve_margin_x
card.comment: sleeve overhang each side of the card; a penny sleeve is symmetric

card.name: sleeve_margin_y
card.comment: sleeve overhang top and bottom of the card

placement.name: active_cx
placement.comment: LCD active-area centre, from board centre

placement.name: active_cy
placement.comment: LCD active-area centre, from board centre

placement.name: lcd_w
placement.comment: LCD module outline long axis, driven landscape so it lies along X (datasheet 34.0 x 45.82)

placement.name: lcd_h
placement.comment: LCD module outline short axis along Y. The module is a build property: no PCB footprint fixes it, so it is placed concentric with the active area

placement.name: card_cx_plan
placement.comment: sleeved-card centre X: art-centred, then shifted +1.94 off the nav (plan)

placement.name: nav_clearance
placement.comment: extra shift so the sleeve's left edge clears the nav, which otherwise sits flush at 0

placement.name: card_top_y
placement.comment: sleeved-card top edge (+1.75 over the board top edge)

placement.name: card_bot_y
placement.comment: sleeved-card bottom edge, 28.25 below the board

controls.name: nav_top_z
controls.comment: 5-way nav top; the only front-side feature above the card plane

controls.name: led_h
controls.comment: SK6812MINI height above the board. The repo's neopixel.stp says 0.75, the common part is ~1.6; the conservative value is used so the clearance check has margin

controls.name: led_clearance
controls.comment: minimum gap required between the bracket plate's underside and the tallest front part under it

fasteners.name: insert_od
fasteners.comment: M3 heat-set insert barrel OD (Preciva kit)

fasteners.name: insert_len
fasteners.comment: barrel length: the kit has 6 and 8, but boss+plate depth is only glass_z = 6.0 mm, so an 8 mm insert would break through into the board

fasteners.name: insert_pilot_d
fasteners.comment: pilot bore for the insert; sweep 4.0-4.5 on the coupon

fasteners.name: m3_shank_d
fasteners.comment: M3 shank; line-to-line in the 3.0 board holes (fits, photo-verified)

fasteners.name: m3_head_d
fasteners.comment: M3 socket-cap head diameter; verify with calipers

fasteners.name: m3_head_h
fasteners.comment: M3 socket-cap head height; verify with calipers

fasteners.name: bolt_spacer
fasteners.comment: spacer under each bolt head: an 8 mm bolt spans 1.6 mm of board + 6.4 mm into a 6.0 mm insert, so the tip would poke through at the card plane by 0.4 mm; the spacer pulls it back

design.name: side_clearance
design.comment: per-side slide clearance; plan says 0.3-0.4 until the coupon

design.name: backplate_thk
design.comment: printed back plate, set coplanar with the 6.00 glass plane

design.name: boss_wall
design.comment: wall around the heat-set insert boss; 1.5 mm keeps a D8 boss inside the board edge (the holes are only ~4.05 mm in), and the insert's upper half is surrounded by the plate anyway

design.name: bar_inset
design.comment: how far the bracket's ends sit inboard of the board edge

design.name: rib_y
design.comment: support rib under the plate: at this Y it merges with both bosses, clears the LED row by >1 mm, and runs only over mask-covered board

design.name: rib_thk
design.comment: support rib thickness. Without it the plate's underside is a ~106 mm unsupported span; with it the part prints with no support material and the span is broken into ~5 mm

design.name: bar_y0
design.comment: bottom bracket rear edge Y: below the art window (-15.5) so it is on the card's blank margin, and above the board edge (-32.007) so it stays supported

design.name: bar_y1
design.comment: bottom bracket front edge Y; clears the LCD module, whose lower edge is about -18.66

clamp.name: clamp_x_l
clamp.comment: left clamp axis X, symmetric about the card centre; the contact is below the art window so only the rectangle matters, and the clamp is on the sleeve

clamp.name: clamp_x_r
clamp.comment: right clamp axis X, symmetric about the card centre; 48 mm apart so two clamps resist card rotation

clamp.name: tower_x_l
clamp.comment: left tower centre X; clear of the sleeve's left edge so nothing above the card plane intersects the card

clamp.name: tower_x_r
clamp.comment: right tower centre X; clear of the sleeve's right edge

clamp.name: tower_w
clamp.comment: tower width along X; the arm is the same width and reaches inward to the clamp

clamp.name: arm_end_over
clamp.comment: how far the arm runs past the clamp axis, so the insert has material all round

clamp.name: arm_thk
clamp.comment: arm thickness; deliberately equal to bolt_shank so a stock bolt's tip lands at the arm's underside

clamp.name: arm_clear
clamp.comment: gap between the arm's underside and the cartridge top at rest

clamp.name: cartridge_h
clamp.comment: cartridge height from its contact face to its top

clamp.name: cartridge_od
clamp.comment: cartridge diameter; loose and swappable, so it needs no socket

clamp.name: pad_od
clamp.comment: compliant pad diameter; the pad is the only part that touches the card

clamp.name: pad_protrusion
clamp.comment: how far the pad stands below the rigid rim; the rim then bottoms on the card and bounds the squeeze, giving clamp_stop_z

clamp.name: bolt_shank
clamp.comment: kit's shortest M3 socket cap; with arm_thk 8.0 the tip lands 0.3 mm above the cartridge

clamp.name: dimple_depth
clamp.comment: centring dimple in the cartridge top for the bolt tip; the bolt is bought, so only the dimple is modelled

clamp.name: knob_od
clamp.comment: printed thumb knob diameter

clamp.name: knob_h
clamp.comment: printed thumb knob height above the arm's top face

clamp.name: knob_pocket_af
clamp.comment: hex pocket across flats, sized to grip the M3 socket-cap head (5.5 across flats)

clamp.name: knob_pocket_depth
clamp.comment: hex pocket depth; the head is 3.0 tall

clamp.name: rail_body_len
clamp.comment: rail cartridge variant: body length along X. At the symmetric clamp axes a 16 mm body stays on the sleeve with margin

clamp.name: rail_body_w
clamp.comment: rail cartridge variant: body width along Y

clamp.name: rail_len
clamp.comment: rail cartridge variant: contact pad length, standing 0.2 mm proud of the rim

clamp.name: rail_w
clamp.comment: rail cartridge variant: contact pad width

clamp.name: rail_park_y
clamp.comment: rails are parked off the assembly: the pad cartridges occupy the clamp axes, and two bodies in the same space would slice as overlapping geometry

top_bar.name: bridge_clear
top_bar.comment: gap from the card plane to the top bridge's underside; the bridge must clear the card AND the START/SELECT actuators, which stand 5.0 mm proud

top_bar.name: bridge_y0
top_bar.comment: top bridge inboard edge Y, clear of the LCD module's upper edge at about 27.16

top_bar.name: hook_clear
top_bar.comment: gap between the card's top edge (33.75) and the hook's inner face

top_bar.name: hook_z
top_bar.comment: bottom of the hook leg; below the card plane (6.0) so it actually captures the card's top edge

coupon.name: coupon_x
coupon.comment: coupon centre X; parked clear of the holder so it prints as its own body

coupon.name: coupon_y
coupon.comment: coupon centre Y, well clear of the holder

coupon.name: coupon_pilot_min
coupon.comment: smallest insert pilot on the coupon sweep

coupon.name: coupon_pilot_step
coupon.comment: pilot sweep step; six bosses cover 4.0 to 4.5 as the plan suggests
